0022600128.text: The Brooklyn Nets (0-3, on a three-game losing streak, fifth in the Atlantic and 14th in the East) visit the Boston Celtics (1-1, third in the Atlantic and eighth in the East) for the Nets' fourth game of the season. Brooklyn is missing Mikel Brown Jr. (out, rest) and Tyler Bilodeau (out, shoulder sprain), while Boston is without Devin Carter (out, illness). The teams have yet to meet in 2026-27, and Brooklyn lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 148-111 defeat in Boston on February 27, 2026.
